Patient.title: Hospital Patient
Patient.description: Hospital ICU patient profile linked to saline IV bag monitoring and supply analytics.

patientCode.description: Hospital MRN or ward patient identifier code.

wardBed.description: Hospital ward and bed location (e.g., ICU-A Bed 04).

diagnosis.description: Primary clinical diagnosis or IV therapy indication.

prescribedBagMl.description: Prescribed saline bottle capacity in milliliters.

prescribedRateMlHr.description: Prescribed IV infusion rate in mL/hr.

attendingClinician.description: Attending physician or ICU nurse name.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when patient record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when patient record was last updated.

InfusionSession.title: Saline Bottle Infusion Session
InfusionSession.description: Telemetry record capturing how much saline volume/bottles were used and time taken for hospital and investment analytics.

patientId.description: Reference ID of the hospital patient document.

wardBed.description: Ward and bed snapshot at time of infusion.

volumeUsedMl.description: Actual saline fluid consumed in milliliters.

bottlesConsumed.description: Equivalent saline bottle count consumed (volumeUsedMl / bottleCapacityMl).

durationSeconds.description: Actual time taken for the infusion session in seconds.

estimatedTimeMinutes.description: Projected total time to reach 10% clamp threshold in minutes.

clampTriggered.description: Whether the SG90 pinch-clamp automatically engaged at <=10%.

status.description: Final outcome state of the saline bottle session.

notes.description: Optional clinical or supply observation note.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when infusion session was logged.

/patients/{patientId}.description: Hospital ICU patient profiles owned by verified authenticated clinicians.

/infusionSessions/{sessionId}.description: Logged saline bottle volume consumption and infusion time-taken records linked to hospital patients.
